best_match.fbbt_definition: Large, acidophilic cell found in rows under the epidermis of each abdominal segment. Two dorsal rows run from the heart tube to the spiracle, close to the posterior boundary of the segment. A single, or sometimes split, transverse row is found under each sternite.
